meta.target: 2019 Classic Phase1; community1.12 reference only, not official2019 fidelity certification
meta.grouping: All encounter grouping, route ordering, side-route choice, and render layout are 2D adaptations. SQL linking and per-GUID spawn alternatives are separately retained. No literal original pull sizes or map collision/navigation geometry is claimed.
meta.verticality: Use source z / named floor when drawing. Ship floors overlap in x/y. Do not flatten aggro distance or traversability.
meta.patrolHandling: Original source movement points retained. Event patrol injection order in route is a 2D simplification; original patrols originate behind players.
meta.randomSpawnHandling: 52 GUIDs with creature.id=0 each resolve two creature_spawn_entry choices,50% each by core uniform selection. Never spawn both alternatives.
meta.rareHandling: Miner Johnson20%; substitute Rat80%. Rat is ambient, not another boss.
